Dave Matthews Band
August 24, 2019
Fiddler's Green Ampitheatre
Greenwood Village, CO




Taper: Rockinman 
Location: Rear of GA PIT, Right Stack, mics A-B config, stand @ 6 feet
Source: akg/ck63 (hypercaps)>Nbob active cables>Lunatec V3>Marantz PMD661(SPDIF In) @ 24/48 kHz
Transfer: PMD661->USB->PC
Conversion: 24/48kHz wav->Sound Forge Pro 10> iZotope 64-Bit SRC & iZotope MBIT+ for resample and dither to 16/44.1 kHz, No normalization, Fade in and fade out applied,20 Band Graphic EQ applied for bass reduction->Waves L3 Ultramaximizer applied->CD Wave Editor->Flac (level 8)> Foobar 2000 for tagging 

************************************************************************************
*****************DO NOT ENCODE THIS SHOW TO LOSSY FORMATS*************************** 
*******************DO NOT SELL OR DISTRIBUTE FOR PROFIT*****************************
************************************************************************************

Notes:
Due to venue Security policy for this show, the mic stand had to be at head height. You will hear talking and yelling in between songs but not nearly as bad as the previous night's show.
